title: IVG Pro 12 Strawberry Kiwi Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Kiwi IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods balance soft, juicy Strawberry with the sharp tang of fresh Kiwi for a smooth yet lively fruit blend. The sweetness of Strawberry is lifted by the tropical brightness of Kiwi, creating a rounded, refreshing flavour that stays vibrant throughout. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically replenishes the pod as you vape, so there’s no need for refilling or coil replacement. Mesh coil technology provides even heating and clear MTL vapour, while the secure click-fit design keeps setup fast and clean. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
